name: Screen Mirroring
author: Glenn Arnold Barosen
description: Mirror your desktop to an Apple TV or other AirPlay 2 receiver, from the bar

barWidget.description: AirPlay receiver list with connect, disconnect and pairing

schema.label: Hardware encoder
schema.description: H.264 encoder passed to doubletake when this plugin starts it: auto, vaapi, nvenc, openh264, or none for software x264. Leave on auto unless auto picks wrong.

schema.label: UDP port range
schema.description: Consecutive UDP ports doubletake may bind for receiver timing and audio (1-65535, minimum 3 ports). Configure your firewall separately.
